*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]

*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]], [[Controversies of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]
***At least 23 people are killed and others are injured as heavy clashes breaks out across the [[South West State of Somalia]], as forces loyal to [[List of leaders of South West State of Somalia|former president]] [[Abdiaziz Laftagareen]] launch a major armed assault on troops of [[Aden Madobe]] and [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]]. ***At least 50 people are killed and 58 others are injured in a [[Tatmadaw]] [[airstrike]] on a market area in [[Kyauktaw]], [[Rakhine State]], [[Myanmar]]. **[[Flood]]ing and [[landslide]]s kill at least eight people each in [[Myanmar]] and [[Thailand]], while 20 to 30 people remain missing in [[Tanintharyi Region]] and more than 1.7 million people across [[Bangkok]] and 27 [[Thai provinces]] are affected. **[[Hurricane Polo]] causes flooding, [[power outage]]s, [[coastal flooding]], and evacuations in [[Baja California Sur]], [[Mexico]], as the [[Category 3 hurricane|Category 3]] storm approaches the [[Pacific coast]], becoming the first [[Pacific hurricane]] of the 2026 season to make [[landfall]]. *An [[avalanche]] kills four [[Mountaineering|climbers]] and leaves 12 others missing at the [[base camp]] of the [[Himalayas|Himalayan]] mountain [[Nemjung]] in [[Manang District, Nepal|Manang District]], Nepal, as heavy snowfall hampers rescue operations.
